entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit customer support. How may I assist you today?
Yeah, hi. I need to return something. It’s this VeloBand Pulse I bought. It's junk. Doesn't work like it should.
I understand. I'm sorry to hear you're having trouble with your VeloBand Pulse. Can you please provide me with your order number or the email address associated with your purchase?
It's [customer email address]. And hurry it up, I don't have all day.
Thank you. Let me pull up your order. Okay, I see your purchase of the VeloBand Pulse on [Date of purchase]. What seems to be the issue with the smart watch?
It keeps disconnecting, the heart rate monitor is all over the place, and it just feels cheap. I want to return it. What's the return policy anyway?
Our standard return policy allows for returns within 90 days of purchase. Since you purchased the VeloBand Pulse recently, you are well within that window. I can certainly process a return for you.
Ninety days? Seriously? Took you long enough! Okay, fine, just get it done. What do I need to do?

To initiate the return, I'll email you a prepaid shipping label. You'll just need to package the VeloBand Pulse securely, attach the label, and drop it off at any authorized shipping location. Once we receive the returned item, we'll issue a full refund to your original payment method. This process may take a few business days. I'm sending the email now. Is there anything else I can help you with today?
So, I just stick it in a box and send it back? That's it? What about the money?

Yes, exactly. Once we receive the returned VeloBand Pulse, the refund will be processed back to your original payment method. You should see it reflected within 7-10 business days. Let me make a note on the account so our returns team knows to expedite the refund. While the VeloBand Pulse itself has a shorter return window of 10 days in some instances, I've confirmed you're well within our extended policy due to a promotional event we had running at the time of purchase. However, in rare cases like this, a manager might review it. But don't worry, I've already pre-approved it.
Okay. Well, that's a relief. Thanks for sorting that out. I appreciate it.
You're very welcome. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
Have a great day, and thank you for choosing VeloFit!
